bio.text: Andrew Chesney is a Republican member of the Illinois Senate for the 45th District, serving since 2023, according to the Illinois General Assembly, after representing the 89th House District from 2018 to 2023.
Chesney's legislature biography describes a small business owner and Carroll County native raised in Shannon, Illinois, who graduated cum laude from Arizona State University.
It says Chesney is a former Freeport City Council member.
